item.title: SMC Infrastructure Ready For Peak Undas Travel Season
item.description: SMC Infrastructure is preparing for a 10 percent increase in vehicle traffic across its expressways during the Undas holiday period, with additional personnel, emergency response teams, and traffic management measures in place to handle the expected surge. Read More »

item.description: Geely Motor Philippines (GMP) introduces its new flagship SUV, the Monjaro EM-i. The Monjaro EM-i pairs Geely’s EM-i Super Hybrid PHEV technology with the performance and security of an all-wheel drive system—a first for the country. Read More »

item.title: Toyota, Yaskawa deploy AI robots in GR Kart production
item.description: Toyota GAZOO Racing and Yaskawa Electric have begun using an AI-equipped robot to weld frames for the GR Kart, taking technology first developed for race-car roll cages into a regular production process.

item.title: One for the ages: Antonelli set to break F1’s youngest champion record
item.description: Mexico City, Mexico (AFP) — Kimi Antonelli will take his place in Formula One’s record books as the youngest champion and Italy’s first since 1953, barring a wild swing of unexpected misfortunes amid a fiesta atmosphere at this weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix.
